BEHIND THE WORK

The questionThe explorationWhere it stands

The question

What would an assistant look like if local ownership, practical hardware limits and extensible skills shaped the design from the start?

The exploration

An early personal project on a Windows laptop, focused on learning how models, memory and modular capabilities fit together.

Where it stands

This is an exploration, not a finished autonomous assistant. Local models still have context, capability and hardware limits; running locally does not make intelligence unlimited.
